base.heading: Mission 003: base styles
base.paragraph: A host page links tokens.css and then base.css, and its text is set in Schibsted Grotesk at the regular scale, in ink on canvas. Tab to the link, the button or the field to see the focus ring.
list: Form controls inherit the page font.

compact.heading: Drift: 003-base-styles
compact.paragraph: A dense screen marks its root with the compact hook, so every part inside it is set at 14 px with a line height of 1.5, while the rem tokens keep their values.

prose.title: Mission 003: the prose family
prose.intro: A host's Markdown renderer emits plain HTML into a container with the prose hook, and the document reads at a line height of 1.65 with paragraphs held to a reading measure. Read the
list: Headings from h1 to h6, paragraphs and block quotes.
Inline code and code blocks, which wrap inside their own width.
prose.nestedLabel: Tables, in their own scroll box:
nested: header cells at 12 px with tabular figures;
prose.quote: Tables and code blocks may use the full width of the container; running text keeps to about 68 characters.
